title: Reconciliation result
description: What the Comparator (reconciliation) returns for one work order: how the new input relates to existing records. This is an LLM judgement; code checks it before acting on it.

classification.description: new: no existing record covers this. update: adds to or changes an existing record without replacing it. reaffirmation: restates an existing record with nothing new. supersession: replaces an existing record with a different one.

target_id.description: ID of the existing record this input relates to. Must be one of the candidate IDs provided. Omit when classification is new.

reason.description: One or two sentences explaining the classification.
